Vehicle barriers for passenger vehicles shall be designed to resist a concentrated load of 6,000 pounds (26.70 kN) in accordance with Section 4.5.3 of ASCE 7.
Garages accommodating trucks and buses shall be designed in accordance with an approved method that contains provisions for traffic railings.
